site.description: Flame-grilled burgers in Barrio de Salamanca, Madrid. Galician blonde beef, bakery bread and fire. Nothing else.

hero.quote: There is no second chance at a first burger.

one.label: Chapter I
one.title: The beef
one.sub: Three cuts. One fire. No excuses.

four.label: Chapter IV
four.title: Where it comes from
four.sub: Your food has a name and surname.

spec.label: Technical sheet
spec.body: Galician blonde beef. Aged 45 days. Ground at 07:00 the same morning.

chef.body: Seven courses. No menu. No questions. Whatever is in the fridge and on the grill that night.
chef.closedToday: No chef's table today. Thursday, Friday and Saturday.

lista.label: The grill list
lista.title: Know first
lista.body: When a special cut comes in, or the chef makes something that isn't on the menu, we tell this list first. Four emails a year. Not one more.
lista.ok: You're in. We'll be in touch.
lista.error: That didn't go through. Try again.
lista.legal: Just the email. Nothing else. Leave whenever you want.

carta.empty: Nothing matches your filters. Try removing one.

grupos.title: Groups
grupos.body: Company dinners, birthdays, whatever it is. From 12 to 30 people. Set menu or open menu, we'll talk it through.

fields.name: Name
fields.message: Anything you want to tell us

la-castiza.name: The classic
la-castiza.ingredients: Twenty-four month cheddar, burnt onion, sour pickle, house sauce. Nothing to explain.
la-castiza.story: The first one we made and the one we will never touch. Properly burnt onion, not caramelised. The pickle cuts through all of it.

la-roja.name: The red one
la-roja.ingredients: Acorn-fed chorizo, roast piquillo, melted Torta del Casar, black garlic. Hot enough to remember.
la-roja.story: It came out of a kitchen argument about whether chorizo belongs in a burger. The side that said yes won.

la-doble.name: The double
la-doble.ingredients: Two patties seared to order, double cheddar, raw onion, mustard. Two hands, no talking.
la-doble.story: There is no technique. There are two patties. The trick is searing them apart and joining them at the end so neither one drowns.

la-verde.name: The green one
la-verde.ingredients: Smoked aubergine, piquillo pepper, goat yoghurt and cold mint. Gentle. Then the fire comes back.
la-verde.story: The aubergine goes on the same grill as the beef. That's why it tastes like this and not like a diet plate.

la-brava.name: The bold one
la-brava.ingredients: Roast chickpea, beetroot, tahini and quick pickle. Vegan without apologising.
la-brava.story: It took us eight months to stop it falling apart on the grill. Roasting the chickpeas was the answer.

la-de-caza.name: The game one
la-de-caza.ingredients: Venison, roast chestnut, quince and blue cheese. Only while the season lasts.
la-de-caza.story: It arrives in October and leaves in December. We don't order it frozen the rest of the year, and that's why it tastes the way it does.

patatas-bravas.name: Bravas potatoes
patatas-bravas.ingredients: Two sauces, one of them bites.

batata-brasa.name: Flame-grilled sweet potato
batata-brasa.ingredients: Whole sweet potato, ash, oil and coarse salt.

aros-de-cebolla.name: Onion rings
aros-de-cebolla.ingredients: Sweet onion, beer batter, smoked salt.

ribera.name: Ribera del Duero
ribera.note: Tinta fina. Serious without being heavy.

mencia.name: Mencía
mencia.note: From Bierzo. Fresh, goes with everything.

verdejo.name: Verdejo
verdejo.note: Rueda. Cuts straight through the fat.

la-erilla.name: Finca La Erilla
la-erilla.note: Pasture-raised Galician blonde. They send the whole animal and we butcher it here.

huerta-aranjuez.name: Huerta de Aranjuez
huerta-aranjuez.note: Seasonal vegetables from 50 km away. What there is, is what there is, and it changes every month.

obrador-cava-baja.name: Obrador de la Cava Baja
obrador-cava-baja.note: Brioche fermented for 36 hours. It arrives every morning at seven.
